decision: Decide whether any alternative tool-result encoding should advance to a larger production-faithful agent benchmark, separately by tool and success/negative scenario.
claim_boundary: This measures comprehension of simulated post-tool OpenCode continuations derived from genuine provider request structure and genuine LCI outputs. It does not measure live tool selection, task completion, or production rollout value.

population.tools: all 14 tools exposed by the frozen LCI MCP tools/list

experimental_unit: one stateless direct continuation request for one tool/scenario/model/arm/repetition
scenario_selection: For every live tool, one frozen successful request from the prior genuine MCP capture bank and one preselected missing/empty/error/corrective request executed against the same frozen PocketBase corpus.
request_derivation: For each model, start from its successful sanitized live OpenCode provider capture. Replace the final user request, assistant tool call name/arguments/reasoning summary, and exact tool result to form the task fixture. Within a task, treatment changes only the selected tool message content.
oracle_protocol: Named deterministic heuristics first. Every provisional failure is exhaustively sent to a blinded cross-model structured LLM adjudicator. A correct adjudication cannot directly overwrite a score: it creates a regression candidate, the deterministic heuristic is repaired with positive/adversarial tests, and the full analysis is rerun. Selection is blocked while any adjudication remains.
success_oracle: Require all independently frozen answer atoms supported by the genuine output and reject unsupported contradictory claims.
negative_oracle: Distinguish explicit tool error, successful empty/not-found, and usable corrective/fallback output; require the answer not to invent requested results.
controls: All codecs must decode to the identical canonical source value.
Every treatment request must differ from its production control at exactly the selected tool-content pointer.
Arm order is cyclically position-balanced across task/repetition rows and model order alternates.
Success and negative scenarios are reported separately; tools and models are never pooled for selection.
selection_rule: An arm may advance for a tool/scenario only with complete adjudication, no failed controls, no completion harm greater than 0.125, paired exact improvement at least 0.25, and Holm-adjusted two-sided McNemar p below 0.05. Two repetitions cannot satisfy the inferential threshold, so v1 is explicitly a transport/oracle pilot and cannot advance an arm; it may only identify designs for a preregistered higher-repetition v2.
failure_policy: Persist every attempt. Provider transport/quota/5xx failures may retry twice only after the initial grid; all other failures remain unscored. Never score infrastructure failures as wrong answers or retry answered cells.
stopping_rule: Execute exactly 448 planned cells, then stop. Do not add repetitions based on observed outcomes.
